subject: english
title: 九上英语同步章节卷 · 学习方法与节日
label: 学习方法 · 节日与习俗（宾语从句 that / if / whether）
unit: 九上·学习方法 / 节日与习俗
source: 九年级上学期“学习方法”“节日与习俗”话题：by + doing 表方式、how to do、宾语从句（that / if / whether 引导，陈述语序，主句过去时从句时态呼应、客观真理用一般现在时）、感叹句（What / How）、the more ..., the more ...。作者结合备考经验，按九年级单元测试题型编写（不含听力），百分制

items.stem:
—How do you study for a test?
—I study ______ working with a group.
items.exp: by＋doing 表示“通过……方式”，回答 How 提问的学习方法。

items.stem: Could you tell me ______ you will go to the Lantern Festival this evening?
items.exp: 从句意思是“你今晚是否去”，用 whether（或 if）引导。that 不表示“是否”；what、which 在从句里要作成分，这里从句不缺成分。

items.stem: I wonder ______ now.
items.exp: 宾语从句用陈述语序：疑问词＋主语＋谓语。now 说明用一般现在时。坑点：A、C 还是疑问句语序。

items.stem: ______ beautiful the lanterns are!
items.exp: 感叹的中心是形容词 beautiful，句型 How＋形容词＋主语＋谓语！the lanterns 是主语，不是被修饰的名词。

items.stem: ______ exciting news it is!
items.exp: 中心词是名词 news，用 What；news 不可数，前面不能加 an。坑点：看到 exciting 以元音开头就选 What an。

items.stem: Our teacher told us that the earth ______ around the sun.
items.exp: 主句是过去时，宾语从句一般用过去的某种时态；但从句说的是客观真理，仍用一般现在时 goes。

items.stem: My spoken English is poor. I'm afraid of ______ mistakes in front of others.
items.exp: be afraid of doing sth. 害怕做某事，of 是介词，后接动名词。

items.stem:
—I don't know ______ to improve my pronunciation.
—Why not listen to the tapes and repeat after them?
items.exp: improve 后面已经有宾语 my pronunciation，不缺成分，用 how to do 表示“怎样做”。what to do 后面不能再有宾语。

items.stem: Reading aloud every morning is a good way to improve your ______.
items.exp: your 后接名词，pronunciation 发音。pronounce 是动词，注意两个词拼写不同（pronunciation 中间是 -nun-）。

items.stem: He stayed up late last night. He was so ______ that he couldn't keep awake in class.
items.exp: so＋形容词＋that；人感到累用 tired，tiring 是“令人累的”，形容事情。

items.stem: I'm not sure whether it ______ tomorrow. If it ______, we won't go to the temple fair.
items.exp: whether 引导宾语从句，按句意用将来时 will rain；if 引导条件状语从句，主将从现，用 rains。坑点：两个“if/whether”从句的规则不一样。

items.stem: If you don't know a word, you can ______ in a dictionary.
items.exp: look up 查阅，代词 it 要放在 look 和 up 中间。look for 寻找，look after 照顾。

items.stem:
—Do you know when the Dragon Boat Festival is?
—It's ______ the fifth day of the fifth lunar month.
items.exp: 具体某一天前用 on。

items.stem: The more you practice, ______ you will speak.
items.exp: “the＋比较级, the＋比较级”表示“越……就越……”。

items.stem:
—Can you tell me ______?
—Sure. Next Monday.
items.exp: 答语 Next Monday 说明是将来，用 will；宾语从句用陈述语序。D 时态不对，A、C 语序不对。

sections.title: How I Learned to Speak English
sections.passage:
When I was in Grade 7, English was my (16) subject. I couldn't understand the teacher, and I was afraid to speak in class because I thought others would (17) at me.
One day my English teacher, Ms. Wang, asked me to stay after class. She asked me (18) I liked watching movies. I said yes. She smiled and said, "Then you can learn English (19) watching English movies."
That night I chose a cartoon. At first I could only understand a few words, so I (20) the Chinese subtitles. After a few weeks, I found that I could understand (21) even without them. I also wrote down useful sentences in a notebook and (22) them aloud every morning.
Ms. Wang also told me (23) mistakes are a part of learning. So I began to answer questions in class, (24) my English wasn't perfect.
Now English is my favorite subject. I think the secret to learning English is not being smart, but (25) to practice every day.

items.exp: 后文“听不懂老师讲课、不敢开口”，说明英语是最难的科目；结尾“现在成了最喜欢的科目”形成对比。
怕别人嘲笑自己：laugh at 嘲笑。
问“是否喜欢看电影”，用 if（whether）引导宾语从句。
by＋doing“通过看英文电影”学英语。
一开始只听得懂几个词，所以打开中文字幕；后文 even without them 说明后来不用字幕也能看懂。
几周以后进步了，不看字幕也能听懂更多。
read ... aloud 大声朗读，是练口语的好办法。
从句是一个完整的陈述“犯错是学习的一部分”，用 that 引导。
“尽管英语还不完美”，也开始回答问题，表让步用 even though。
not ..., but ... 前后并列：秘诀不是聪明，而是愿意每天练习。be willing to do 愿意做。

groups.label: A
groups.title: Festivals Around the World
groups.passage:
Spring Festival (China): It is the most important festival in China. It usually comes in January or February. People clean their houses, put up red couplets and eat dumplings. Children get red packets with lucky money from their parents and grandparents.
Thanksgiving (the USA): It is on the fourth Thursday of November. Families get together for a big dinner. The main dish is usually turkey. People give thanks for the good things in their lives.
Songkran (Thailand): It is the Thai New Year and comes in the middle of April. People throw water at each other on the streets. They believe that water can wash away bad luck. It is also a time to visit older family members.

items.stem: When is Thanksgiving?
options: On the fourth Thursday of November.
On the first day of the year.
items.exp: It is on the fourth Thursday of November。

items.stem: What do Chinese children get during the Spring Festival?
items.exp: Children get red packets with lucky money。对联是贴的，不是孩子收到的。

items.stem: Why do people throw water at each other during Songkran?
options: Because the weather is very hot.
Because they want to wash away bad luck.
Because they want to clean the streets.
Because water is cheap in Thailand.
items.exp: They believe that water can wash away bad luck。

items.stem: What do the three festivals have in common?
items.exp: 春节一家人团聚、给孩子红包，感恩节家人聚餐，泼水节看望长辈，都和家人有关。泼水节在四月，不是冬天。

items.stem: Where can you probably read this passage?
items.exp: 介绍各国节日风俗，属于文化类读物。

groups.label: B
groups.title: Different Ways to Learn
groups.passage:
Everyone learns in a different way. Some people are "visual learners". They learn best by looking at pictures, maps and charts. If you are a visual learner, you can draw mind maps when you review your lessons.
Other people are "listening learners". They remember things better when they hear them. They like to discuss problems with classmates or listen to recordings. Reading new words aloud also helps them a lot.
There are also "doing learners". They find it hard to sit still for a long time. They learn best by doing things with their hands, such as doing experiments or making models. Taking short breaks while studying is a good idea for them.
Most of us use all three ways, but one of them usually works best. Knowing which kind of learner you are can help you study more effectively. So why not try different ways and find out what works best for you?

items.stem: How do visual learners learn best?
options: By looking at pictures and charts.
items.exp: They learn best by looking at pictures, maps and charts。

items.stem: Which is a good idea for listening learners?
items.exp: Reading new words aloud also helps them a lot。画思维导图是给视觉型的建议。

items.stem: The word "effectively" in the last paragraph probably means "______".
items.exp: 知道自己是哪类学习者，能帮你学得“更有效”，即效果更好。

items.stem: What advice does the writer give to "doing learners"?
options: Study for a long time without rest.
items.exp: Taking short breaks while studying is a good idea for them。

items.stem: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Different people learn in different ways.
Everyone should learn the same way.
items.exp: 首句 Everyone learns in a different way 是中心句，全文介绍三种学习方式。

sections.title: My Spring Festival
sections.passage:
Last Spring Festival, I went back to my hometown with my parents. It was the (36) (happy) time of the year for me.
Before the festival, we cleaned the house and put up red couplets. My grandma taught me how (37) (make) dumplings. Mine looked funny, but she said they were (38) (real) nice.
On New Year's Eve, the whole family had a big dinner together. We (39) (watch) the Spring Festival Gala on TV while (40) (eat). At midnight, we heard fireworks everywhere. (41) ______ exciting night it was!
The next morning, I got red packets from my grandparents. I asked my dad (42) ______ I could spend the money on books, and he agreed.
I think the Spring Festival is important (43) ______ it brings families together. I hope (44) (go) back to my hometown again next year. I am sure my grandparents will be (45) (please) to see us again.

items.exp: the＋最高级＋of ...“一年中最快乐的时光”；happy 变最高级先改 y 为 i 再加 -est。
how to do 怎样做。
修饰形容词 nice 用副词 really。
讲去年春节的事，用一般过去时。
while doing 在做……的时候，主语相同，从句省略成 while eating。
中心词是可数名词单数 night，用 What＋an＋形容词＋名词。exciting 以元音音素开头用 an。
问“是否可以”，用 if 或 whether 引导宾语从句。
后面是重要的原因：因为它把家人团聚在一起。
hope to do sth. 希望做某事。
be pleased to do sth. 很高兴做某事，人的感受用 pleased。

sections.prompt: 学校英语角以“How I Learn English”为题征文。请写一篇短文：1. 你学英语时遇到过什么困难；2. 你用了哪些方法（至少两种），效果如何；3. 给同学一条建议。要求：80 词左右，文中不得出现真实姓名和校名。
points: 写出学英语遇到的困难
写出至少两种学习方法并说明效果
语言正确（by doing、宾语从句等），书写规范
sections.sample:
How I Learn English
When I started junior high school, English was difficult for me. I couldn't remember new words, and I was afraid to speak in class.
Later I found some good ways. First, I learn new words by reading them aloud and using them in sentences. Now I can remember them more easily. Second, I improve my listening by watching English cartoons. At first I needed the subtitles, but now I can understand much more without them. I also keep a notebook for my mistakes and review it every week.
My advice is: don't be afraid of making mistakes. The more you practice, the better you will be.
sections.exp: 写完检查：by 后面用动词 -ing；宾语从句用陈述语序（I found that ...）；用 First / Second / Also 把方法分条写清楚，最后一句点题。
